name: SurveyMonkey
description: SurveyMonkey's hosted server reads surveys and their responses so the agent can summarise results.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (mcp.surveymonkey.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
